prompt:
Generate an image of a wrist roller trainer, a mechanical device for exercising the forearm and wrist, with the following features: a straight cylindrical rotating grip shaft that can be turned by two hands, a long cord or flat strap wrapped several turns around the center of the shaft with the free end hanging vertically, and a compact loading pin attached to the end of the cord, holding one black weight plate. The rotating shaft is visibly winding the cord and lifting the plate when turned. 

The device consists of a sturdy frame that allows the cylindrical shaft to rotate freely, the shaft itself made of a durable material, a cord or strap that wraps around the center of the shaft, a loading pin that holds the weight plate, and the weight plate which is a simple, solid, circular disc. 

The distinguishing features of this equipment include the rotating cylindrical grip shaft, the cord or strap wrapped around it, and the single weight plate hanging from the end of the cord. 

The equipment must not have the following features: a fixed D-ring, a strap merely stitched to the handle without wrapping around the shaft, a T-shaped carry handle, a cable-row handle, a person rolling the device, a barbell, an EZ bar, a dumbbell, a rack, any text, watermark, or logo.

The image should be a studio product photograph with the wrist roller trainer positioned in a front three-quarter view at an angle of approximately 35 degrees, the camera at the mid-height of the product, and the whole object visible with generous margins. The background is a pure, seamless white. The product has matte black and graphite surfaces, restrained brushed steel for the metallic parts, and black upholstery where applicable. The lighting is soft and diffused studio lighting. A subtle contact shadow is present under the device.

The image should not contain any unwanted objects, incorrect machine types, persons, body parts, rooms, logos, trademarks, labels, readable or invented text, watermarks, collages, cropped components, duplicated components, or mechanically impossible structures. All surfaces must be blank and unbranded. 

The final image prompt is: 
A mechanically correct forearm wrist roller trainer on a solid pure white background one straight cylindrical rotating grip shaft a long strong cord or flat strap visibly wrapped several turns around the center of that shaft and the free end hanging vertically to a compact loading pin holding one black weight plate rotating the shaft must visibly wind the cord and lift the plate centered front three-quarter view around 35 degrees camera at product mid-height the whole object visible with generous margins pure seamless white background matte black and graphite surfaces restrained brushed steel black upholstery where applicable soft diffused studio lighting and a subtle contact shadow no unwanted object incorrect machine type person body part room logo trademark label readable or invented text watermark collage cropped component duplicated component mechanically impossible structure all surfaces blank and unbranded.
